text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower goes to watch the spring Tenno Sho with Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She watches as Mejiro McQueen enthralls the audience with her magnificant performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing how McQueen brings happiness to many people, Rice compares her to a blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And believing that she herself, in contrast, brings misfortune to those around her, Rice Shower says it is her dream to become a blue rose one day as well.
